newsitem.title: USA: MacMillan Bloedel stake held by Taylor group.
newsitem.headline: MacMillan Bloedel stake held by Taylor group.

text.p: A group including Thomas Taylor and the Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan Board said Monday it holds a 9.5 percent stake in Macmillan Bloedel Ltd, or 11,862,474 common shares.
In a filing with the U.S, Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest purchases were between Feb 4 and March 21 at $12.71 to $13.95 per share.
The shares were bought with Canadian dollars and the price per share listed reflected the U.S. dollar equivalent based on the March 12 exchange rate, according to the filing.
The group holds the stake for investment.
Taylor is president of Taylor and Co, the investment partner of the Bass Family of Fort Worth, Texas.
MacMillan, based in Vancouver, British Colombia, is in the forest products business, chiefly raw materials and building materials, pulp and paper, and linerboard and packaging.
